capabilities: Rewrite selectable PDF text in a chosen built-in or imported font
Read PDFs in a live refont view that redraws pages while scrolling
Export a rewritten PDF beside the original or replace it after saving a restore copy
Import local .ttf/.otf fonts for live reading and export
Skip unsafe or uncertain text and log skipped lines in audit reports
disambiguation: Not an OCR tool; it only redraws text that already has a selectable text layer and leaves image-only scans unchanged.
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile). Automatically downloads a packaged helper binary and font assets from GitHub Releases with SHA-256 verification; all processing is local. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders PDFs in their original typeface and offers no way to change the font inside a PDF without retyping or regenerating the document.

relations.evidence: It opens a PDF in the plugin's own PDF.js view

summary: PDF font tool that redraws selectable PDF text in a chosen font, with a live refont reading view and safe export or in-place rewrite.
